title: Tools
excerpt: Tools MCP [tools] allow servers to expose callable functions to clients. Tools are the primary mechanism for LLMs to take action through MCP—they enable everything from querying databases to calling web APIs. [tools]: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025 11 25/server/tools This document covers tool content types, change notifications, and schema generation.
